profile.headline: IT Consultant | Full Stack Developer | React Developer | C#.Net Developer
profile.summary: Full-stack Software Developer working within an innovative architecture team, consistently engaged with diverse languages and platforms to craft cutting-edge APIs and front-end applications. Core responsibilities include the management of numerous REST APIs across the organization and upgrading legacy applications into adaptable, reusable React applications. These projects, servicing several hundred users within the organization, underscore a passion and commitment to collaborative endeavors aimed at delivering modern, user-centric applications.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
Full Stack Developer at a private wealth management company.

Assisted in managing REST APIs in the WSO2 API management service and guided fellow developers on the creation and utilization of these APIs written in XML. Helped facilitate the transition to a cloud-based infrastructure utilizing the Choreo platform. The Choreo APIs encompass REST and GraphQL and are written in the Ballerina programming language.

Developed custom REST APIs in C#.NET and contributed to their maintenance and managed the manual deployment procedures. These APIs interacted with external vendor APIs or directly with the internal database, employing Ibatis for database connectivity, with queries and stored procedures called within XML files.

Revitalized a 20-year-old VB6 application, a ledger system presenting report data, by migrating its logic and SQL architecture into a modern C#.NET API. Enhancements included paging and filtering functionalities, augmenting its utility and usability.

Modernized internal legacy applications, transitioning them from VB6 and ASP.NET to React Web Applications. Collaborated with stakeholders to enhance the user experience of three longstanding lookup applications. Developed within a new React codebase, leveraging Kendo React components, the project subsequently established a standardized approach for creating reusable components. Visual consistency across applications was heightened, with meticulous attention to CSS customization to align with prototype specifications.

Led the development of a React application emulating Excel spreadsheet functionalities, engaging with QA testers, Business Analysts, and UI/UX designers to refine and enhance its features.

Led UI development with a small team of developers in the creation of a multipage workflow project, featuring various screens and forms. The project migrated the React codebase from using Redux to React Hooks.
